name: agent-protocol-memory-seed-synthetic-expanded
fixture_policy: Small schema-compatible seed records for repeatable simulator tests. Records are synthetic but mapped to open-source dataset families so raw public data can be converted into the same schema without vendoring large external datasets. Expanded deterministically for supplementary-scale protocol ablations.
